utterances.text: The jewelry store on Fenwick. Someone got in through the display case. We found a glass cutter with a suction-cup grip on the floor.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: A glass cutter? I wouldn't know anything about that.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Where were you Tuesday night?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Home. Watched a game. Fell asleep on the couch.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Anyone who can back that up?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: My roommate was in and out. I don't know exactly.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: A neighbor saw a blue sedan parked in the alley behind the store that night. That ring a bell?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No. I don't know anything about a car in an alley.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Fair enough. Let's talk about the timing. The alarm was disabled at 11:40 p.m. Does that sound like a window you'd be awake for?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I mean, I was up. But that doesn't mean anything.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The camera across the street caught someone walking up. Gray hooded sweatshirt, hood up. Sound familiar?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Lots of people own gray hoodies.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Sure. But this one was carrying a canvas duffel bag when they came out. That's a pretty specific look.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don't carry a bag like that. Not my thing.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Let's step back. How do you know the store owner again?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I bought a watch there once. That's it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a lock-pick set near the back door. Any reason your prints would be on something like that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No. I've never used anything like that. I don't know where that came from.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Okay. Let's talk about what was taken. A velvet ring tray came up missing from the case. You ever see something like that in the store?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: A velvet tray? I mean, maybe on a shelf. I wasn't really looking.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The person on the camera had a cut on the left hand. Bleeding a little. You've got a bandage there yourself.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I cut myself in the kitchen. It happens.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: When was that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Couple days ago. Making dinner.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: So you're telling me you were home, you don't know about the car, and you never touched a lock-pick set.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: That's right.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Let's go back to that glass cutter with the suction-cup grip. You said you didn't know anything about it. Where would someone get one of those?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: A hardware store, I guess. The kind with the little suction cup on it. I've seen them at the hardware store.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Right. And the alarm going down at 11:40 p.m. — that's a strange time to be doing anything, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah. Strange.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And the gray hooded sweatshirt — you said lots of people own them. Did you own one?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I had a gray hooded sweatshirt. I think I still do somewhere.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And the canvas duffel bag — you said that's not your thing. But you've seen one around?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah. Sure.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The velvet ring tray — you said maybe on a shelf. Do you remember seeing it in the case?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I remember a velvet ring tray in the case, yeah. Near the front.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And the cut on the left hand — you said you cut yourself in the kitchen. That's your story?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah. That's my story.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Okay. I'm going to step out for a minute. Sit tight.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Can I get some water?

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: I'll have someone bring it.

crime: a shooting that wounded a store clerk

plan.adoption: repeats it in his own words

facts.label: weapon
facts.detail: a snub-nosed .38 revolver with a taped grip

facts.label: location
facts.detail: the back stockroom of the Corner Mart on Delaney Avenue

facts.label: object

facts.label: clothing
facts.detail: a gray hoodie with a tear on the left cuff

facts.label: vehicle

facts.label: time

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Thanks for coming down. You're not under arrest. You want water or anything before we start?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I'm good. Let's just get this over with. I already told the guy at the door I don't know anything about a snub-nose thirty-eight with tape on the grip.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Nobody asked you about a gun yet. Why bring up a revolver with a wrapped handle?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Because that's what people are gonna say, right? Some little wheel gun. I'm just telling you up front it wasn't mine.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Okay. Where were you around nine-thirty last night?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Driving around. Thinking. I do that when I can't sleep.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The clerk who got hurt works the register at the Corner Mart on Delaney. You know that store?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I've been in there. Everybody's been in there.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The back stockroom there, behind the swinging door by the coolers. Ever been back in that room?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: The stockroom behind the coolers at the Delaney store? No. Customers don't go back there.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Let's talk about what got taken. Was there a blue canvas bag involved, the kind they use for cash?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don't know anything about a blue bag.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: A canvas cash bag. Blue. The zipper pull was broken off it.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Yeah, what?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I hear you. Broken zipper, blue bag. Doesn't mean anything to me.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Fair enough. You said you were driving. What were you wearing?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Same thing I always wear when it's cold. That gray hoodie of mine. The one with the rip on the sleeve, left side near the wrist.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: A tear on the left cuff. Anyone else wear that hoodie?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No. It's mine. I've had it for years.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Did you go home and change after your drive?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Eventually. I parked my hatchback out back of my place. Black one. Still missing the front hubcap on the passenger side from that pothole.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The black hatchback with the missing hubcap. Is that the only car you have access to?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: It's the only one I drive.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Let's pin down the timeline. When did you leave your place?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Late. After nine-forty, I know that much, because the lottery machine at the corner store shuts off right around then and I heard it cut out when I drove past.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: So just after nine-forty, when the lottery terminal goes dark. You're sure about that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah. I remember the machine going quiet.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Okay. Let's back up. You brought up a revolver before I said a word about any weapon. Why?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I told you. People talk. I wanted it on record it wasn't mine.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: On record. All right. Did you ever handle a gun like that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No. Never touched a thirty-eight in my life.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Let's talk about the stockroom again. You said customers don't go back there. Who does?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Employees. Deliveries. Not me.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The blue cash bag. Where would somebody put it if they took it?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I wouldn't know. I never saw a blue bag with a busted zipper in my life.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The gray hoodie with the torn cuff. Is it at your apartment right now?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: It's in the laundry. You can look at it. The rip's right there on the left sleeve.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And the hatchback, the black one with the missing hubcap. Where's it parked?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Out back of my building. Same spot as always.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Just after nine-forty, you said. Did you see anyone else near the Delaney store around then?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Maybe one person walking. I wasn't paying attention. It was right when the lottery machine went off, so, you know, just after nine-forty.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: One more time. The gun. The snub-nose with the taped grip. You're telling me you never saw it?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Never saw it. Never held it. That's my story.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: All right. Sit tight. I'm going to get you that water after all.

crime: a car break-in at a mall

plan.adoption: repeats it in his own words

facts.label: weapon
facts.detail: a folding pocket knife with a blue handle, clipped to the suspect's belt

facts.label: location
facts.detail: the north parking deck stairwell of the mall, level 4

facts.label: object
facts.detail: a grey hard-shell suitcase taken from the car's trunk

facts.label: clothing
facts.detail: a bright orange hooded sweatshirt

facts.label: vehicle
facts.detail: a dark green pickup truck with a dented rear bumper

facts.label: time
facts.detail: shortly after 9:15 p.m.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Thanks for sitting down with me. You're not under arrest. You want water or anything before we start?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I'm good. Can we just get this over with? I got work in the morning.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Won't take long if we're straight with each other. Where were you last night around nine?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Around the mall. Killing time, mostly. And before you ask, yeah, I had my knife on me. Blue-handled folder, clipped right here on my belt. I always carry it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Okay. Nobody said anything about a knife, but noted. Why'd you bring it up?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Because cops always find it and make a thing of it. It's a tool, man. I cut boxes with it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Fair enough. Let's talk about the parking structure. Did you go up to the fourth level at all?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Fourth level? No. I don't know anything about the upper deck, and I wasn't in any stairwell up there.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: So if I told you there's a camera covering the north stairwell on level four, what would you say?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I'd say I don't know what that camera shows, 'cause I wasn't there. I don't know anything about it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Alright. Tell me about the grey hard-shell suitcase.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: What about it?

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Was it yours?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah. That's my case. I had it with me.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Where is it now?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: In my truck, I guess. Haven't moved it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Let's back up. What were you wearing yesterday evening?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Jeans, sneakers. Same as always.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Anything over that? A jacket, a hoodie?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: It was chilly, so yeah, I had a hoodie on.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Was it the orange one? The bright orange hooded sweatshirt?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah. The orange one.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Do you still have it?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, it's at my place. In the laundry probably.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: How'd you get to the mall?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Drove.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: What kind of vehicle?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: A pickup. It's old, but it runs.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Is it the dark green truck? The one with the dented rear bumper?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don't know anything about a dented bumper. My truck's fine.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Green, though? Dark green?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I'm not gonna sit here and go through my whole vehicle with you. I don't know what you're talking about.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Okay. Let's talk about timing. When did you leave the mall?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Couldn't tell you exactly. Sometime after nine.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Was it shortly after 9:15 p.m.?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, around a quarter past nine, give or take. Shortly after 9:15, that sounds about right.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And between nine and whenever you left, you were where?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Walking around. Food court, couple stores. Nothing exciting.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Did you touch any cars in that garage?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No. Absolutely not.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: One more time on the case — the grey hard-shell suitcase. Whose is it?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, mine. I already told you.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And the orange sweatshirt — you wore it last night?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Alright. Sit tight, I'll be back in a few minutes.
